title: CWM-1 Lite
summary: CWM-1 Lite powers the most controllable interactive avatars in the world with prices as low as $0.04/min.
body_markdown:
Last week we announced Character World Model-1 (CWM-1), the most controllable interactive avatars in the world.


Today, we’re announcing CWM-1 Lite - the same controllability, now with prices as low as $0.048/min.


To put this into context, Character World Model-1 Lite is cheaper than many TTS and S2S models today. Real-time avatars are now cheap enough for production at scale, not just demos.


If you can afford a voice, you can afford a face.
